reason: The goal calls for cutting the viewing slits, and this is the only available action.
expectation: I expect the marked lines on the drum wall to become slits.

effect: The slits are cut, and the next goal is to roll the wall.
reaction: The change from marked lines to slits is clear.
reason: Rolling the wall follows the goal and is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the slitted strip to form a cylinder, perhaps not yet secured.

effect: The strip is now an open cylinder; the seam needs securing.
reaction: The change from flat strip to drum is clear and satisfying.
reason: Tape should secure the seam, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the cylinder’s seam to be taped closed.

effect: The seam is taped and the slit drum is complete for this chapter.
reaction: The green rectangle makes the tape placement clear, though the drum still feels like part of a larger build.

mostWorthwhile.text: Rolling the cut strip into a cylinder was the most worthwhile step: it made the drum’s shape clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Taping the seam was practical but less visually transformative than rolling the wall.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the changes followed the stated goals.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary: cutting, rolling and securing the wall all had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the slitted drum produces animation; this chapter ends before that payoff.
